authoredSolutions.12: The fringe width is \(\beta=\frac{\lambda D}{d}=\frac{5890\times10^{-10}\times0.5}{5\times10^{-4}}=5.89\times10^{-4}\) m. The distance between the first and third bright fringes is \(2\beta=1.178\times10^{-3}\) m \(=1178\times10^{-6}\) m. Hence option (B).
authoredSolutions.31: At \(273\text{-}278\ K\), aniline is diazotised by \(NaNO_2/HCl\) to benzenediazonium chloride (X). This couples at the para position of the highly activated N,N-dimethylaniline to give the azo dye Y, 4-(N,N-dimethylamino)azobenzene. Hence option (B).
authoredSolutions.33: \(C_2H_5MgBr\) adds to the carbonyl of acetophenone (\(C_6H_5COCH_3\), \(C_8H_8O\)); hydrolysis gives the tertiary alcohol A, 2-phenylbutan-2-ol. Being tertiary (and benzylic), it reacts instantly with Lucas reagent to give the tertiary chloride B, 2-chloro-2-phenylbutane (\(C_{10}H_{13}Cl\)). Hence option (C).
authoredSolutions.35: A non-reducing sugar that hydrolyses to two different reducing monosaccharides is sucrose, which gives glucose and fructose (its two anomeric carbons are locked in the glycosidic bond, so sucrose itself is non-reducing). Hence option (D).
authoredSolutions.37: Acidic hydrolysis of a nitrile proceeds through the amide. The first (partial) step converts cyclohexanecarbonitrile to A, cyclohexanecarboxamide (\(-CONH_2\)); further hydrolysis on heating gives cyclohexanecarboxylic acid. So A is the amide. Hence option (C).
authoredSolutions.43: trans-\([NiBr_2(PPh_3)_2]\) is square planar with the two \(Br\) ligands opposite each other (180\(^\circ\)); meridional-\([Co(NH_3)_3(NO_2)_3]\) is octahedral with the three like ligands occupying a meridian (two trans + one cis). The pair of structures matching both descriptions is option (D).
authoredSolutions.45: Alkaline \(KMnO_4\) oxidises the benzylic methyl group to a carboxylic acid (\(-CH_3\to -COOH\)); the methoxy group is unaffected. So X is 4-methoxybenzoic acid. Hence option (C).

authoredSolutions.77: Continuity/differentiability is only in question at \(|x|=1\). At \(x=1\): continuity gives \(a+b=1\); matching derivatives, \(\frac{d}{dx}\frac1x=-1\) and \(\frac{d}{dx}(ax^2+b)=2a\), so \(2a=-1\Rightarrow a=-\tfrac12\) and \(b=\tfrac32\). Hence option (D).
